title: 2d6 Adventure Stub (non-5e generalization test)
license_note: Original Mag stub for B2 play benchmark — not a commercial RPG.

resolution.note: Total ≥7 succeeds at ordinary tasks; combat is opposed 2d6+mod

crossroads.name: Dusty Crossroads
crossroads.desc: Four ways. A post with carved notches — someone counts journeys, not kills.
hooks: A riddle scratched on the post: what walks without feet when the map is true?

hill_shrine.name: Hill Shrine
hill_shrine.desc: Broken stones. Wind. A bowl for coins long stolen.
hooks: Notches match the crossroads post — same counter.

market_ruin.name: Market Ruin
market_ruin.desc: Stalls collapsed. One stall still shaded.
hooks: The dog guards a child's satchel.

river_ford.name: River Ford
river_ford.desc: Shallow water. Stones placed for small feet.

rest_safe.text: Stars wheel. You mark another notch on a stick.
You dream of a post that writes itself.
